description: Enterprise Golden Ground-Truth Evaluation Benchmark Dataset for Ragas Quality Gates

ground_truth_context.key_policy: OWASP ASVS 4.0 Authentication Architecture: Generic error messages for credential mismatches, TLS 1.3 requirement, zero user enumeration.
Brute Force Defense: Exactly 5 consecutive invalid login attempts within 15 minutes trigger account lockout. Message must state 'Account locked due to 5 failed attempts. Please contact support.'
Testability Contract: Automated tests must bind exclusively to data-testid selectors: input-email, input-password, button-login, alert-error, alert-lockout.

ground_truth_acceptance_criteria: AC1: Valid credentials should login successfully and redirect to dashboard.
AC2: Invalid password should display error message: 'Invalid email or password'.
AC3: Empty email should display validation message: 'Email is required'.
AC4: Empty password should display validation message: 'Password is required'.
AC5: Invalid email format (missing @ or domain) should display validation message: 'Please enter a valid email address'.
AC6: Account should lock after 5 consecutive failed attempts with message: 'Account locked due to 5 failed attempts. Please contact support.'

ground_truth_test_cases.title: Valid credentials login successfully and redirect to dashboard
Invalid password displays generic error message without user disclosure
Empty email field triggers mandatory validation message
Empty password field triggers mandatory validation message
Malformed email format triggers validation message
Account locks after exactly 5 consecutive failed attempts
expected_assertions: expect(page.locator('[data-testid="alert-lockout"]')).to_contain_text('Account locked due to 5 failed attempts. Please contact support.')

ground_truth_context.key_policy: Discount calculations apply to cart subtotal before taxes and shipping. Valid promo SAVE20 awards 20% discount.

ground_truth_acceptance_criteria: AC1: Valid promo code 'SAVE20' should deduct 20% from cart subtotal and display updated total.
AC2: Expired promo code 'EXPIRED10' should display error: 'Coupon code has expired'.
AC3: Unrecognized promo code should display error: 'Invalid coupon code'.
AC4: Submitting empty coupon input should display warning: 'Please enter a coupon code'.
AC5: Applying a second coupon should replace existing coupon or display: 'Only one promo code allowed per order'.
